candidates.name: Salesforce, Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide comprehensive, cloud-based CRM platforms that integrate marketing, sales, and service automation for businesses.
candidates.rationale: Salesforce offers overlapping cloud CRM, marketing, sales, and service automation evaluated by the same go-to-market teams.

candidates.name: Freshworks Inc.
candidates.description: Both offer unified, AI-enabled software suites designed to streamline customer engagement and service operations for growing businesses.
candidates.rationale: Freshworks offers CRM, marketing automation, and customer engagement software evaluated by the same growing-business go-to-market teams as HubSpot.

candidates.name: Zoho
candidates.description: Both provide an extensive ecosystem of cloud-based business applications including CRM, marketing automation, and productivity tools.
candidates.rationale: Zoho offers CRM and marketing automation software evaluated by the same SMB and mid-market go-to-market teams as HubSpot.

candidates.name: Pipedrive
candidates.description: Both offer dedicated CRM platforms focused on sales pipeline management and lead tracking for small to mid-sized businesses.
candidates.rationale: Pipedrive is an SMB-focused CRM for sales pipeline and lead management, directly overlapping HubSpot’s CRM offering and buyer persona.

candidates.name: ActiveCampaign
candidates.description: Both specialize in marketing automation and customer experience platforms that leverage behavioral data to drive customer engagement.
candidates.rationale: ActiveCampaign offers CRM and marketing automation for SMB go-to-market teams, serving substantially the same buyers and customer-engagement workflows as HubSpot.

candidates.name: Brevo, Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide all-in-one customer engagement platforms that combine email marketing, SMS, and CRM functionality.
candidates.rationale: Brevo offers CRM and multichannel marketing automation for SMB go-to-market teams, overlapping HubSpot’s core products and buyer persona.

candidates.name: Creatio Inc.
candidates.description: Both offer low-code platforms that integrate CRM and workflow automation to help businesses manage customer-facing processes.
candidates.rationale: Creatio provides CRM and customer-facing workflow automation, overlapping HubSpot’s core platform and serving similar sales, marketing, and service teams.

candidates.name: Keap
candidates.description: Both focus on providing CRM and marketing automation tools specifically tailored to the needs of small businesses.
candidates.rationale: Keap offers CRM and marketing automation for small businesses, overlapping HubSpot’s core product and serving the same go-to-market buyers.

candidates.name: MailChimp
candidates.description: Both provide marketing automation platforms that help businesses manage customer relationships through email and multi-channel campaigns.
candidates.rationale: Mailchimp overlaps HubSpot in SMB marketing automation, email campaigns, customer management, and multi-channel engagement for the same marketing teams.

candidates.name: SugarCRM
candidates.description: Both offer B2B-focused CRM solutions that utilize data and automation to improve sales productivity and account management.
candidates.rationale: SugarCRM provides CRM, sales automation, and account-management software for the same go-to-market teams and core customer-management workflows as HubSpot.

candidates.name: Insightly, Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide modern, scalable CRM platforms designed to help businesses manage sales pipelines and customer relationships.
candidates.rationale: Insightly offers CRM, sales pipeline, marketing, and customer relationship tools for businesses, overlapping HubSpot’s core platform and go-to-market buyer persona.

candidates.name: Copper CRM, Inc.
candidates.description: Both offer CRM software solutions that emphasize ease of use and integration for service-oriented businesses.
candidates.rationale: Copper is a CRM platform for similar business teams, overlapping HubSpot’s core CRM offering and customer relationship management use case.

candidates.name: Constant Contact, Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide digital marketing platforms that help businesses execute email and online marketing campaigns to reach their audience.
candidates.rationale: Constant Contact’s email marketing and automation platform overlaps HubSpot’s marketing offering and targets the same SMB marketing teams and campaign workflows.

candidates.name: Monday
candidates.description: Both offer work management platforms that use automation and AI to help teams manage projects and customer-facing workflows.
candidates.rationale: Monday offers a sales CRM and automated customer-workflow platform evaluated by go-to-market teams, directly overlapping HubSpot’s core CRM use case.

candidates.name: ClickUp
candidates.description: Both provide comprehensive productivity and work management platforms that consolidate various business tools into a single interface.
candidates.rationale: ClickUp primarily provides project and work management, not CRM and marketing automation for go-to-market teams; the core job-to-be-done differs.

candidates.name: Fynd
candidates.description: Both offer AI-driven platforms that help commerce businesses manage their online presence, sales, and operations.
candidates.rationale: Fynd is an omnichannel commerce platform, not a CRM and marketing-automation solution evaluated for the same go-to-market job.

candidates.name: Talkdesk
candidates.description: Both provide AI-powered customer experience solutions that automate service interactions and improve customer support efficiency.
candidates.rationale: Talkdesk is primarily a contact-center platform, not an SMB CRM and marketing-automation suite; buyers would not evaluate them for the same core job.

candidates.name: 8x8
candidates.description: Both offer integrated communication and contact center solutions that help businesses manage customer interactions through AI and automation.
candidates.rationale: 8x8 primarily provides unified communications and contact-center software, not CRM or marketing automation; buyers use it for a distinct communications job.

candidates.name: Mendix Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide low-code development platforms that enable businesses to build custom applications for customer engagement and internal workflows.
candidates.rationale: Mendix is a low-code application development platform, not a CRM or marketing-automation product evaluated by go-to-market teams for the same job.

candidates.name: Seidor Group
candidates.description: Both provide technology consulting and software solutions, including CRM and ERP, to support digital transformation for businesses.
candidates.rationale: Seidor is primarily a technology consultancy and systems integrator implementing CRM/ERP solutions, not a competing CRM and marketing-automation software platform.
